reason: Alpha.6 PR4' (Lane 2) ships the review-wake DEFER plane as a DARK LANE: a pre-gate on the Leader control-notification port that declines a wake (never a decision) for one identified approval leg while a floor instant stands, plus the refusals and decisions it answers with. NOTHING IS WIRED — no plane flag, no root.ts import, no model-facing tool — because the round-1 review of #509 measured the only wake source in this tree (control/service.ts:2536 fires on created:true only; an existing row never re-notifies; a risen leg is deliberately never notified; approvalCaseId is minted at creation) and concluded a quiet can never be standing when its key's only wake fires, so a tool or a flag shipped today would be a control with nothing on the other end. Four lane modules: types.ts (the six laws — not a scheduler and no replay ever, not a second approval ledger, not a dedupe, not the retry mutex, not an authority, and the F-1 law stating exactly what a quiet can suppress today; the key law that a wake with no readable case is never deferred; the closed vocabularies REVIEW_DEFER_DECISIONS / _WAKE_REASONS (8) / _REFUSALS (9) / _REASON_CODES (4) and the frozen default limits, one hour and sixty-four entries). store.ts (process-local Map keyed by length-prefixed (rootSessionId, approvalCaseId, legOrdinal) so no two legitimate ids can share a slot, sweep-on-every-touch with no reaper and no timer, saturation refusing the NEW key rather than evicting a standing quiet). gate.ts (decideReviewWake pure, side-effect-free except retiring a passed OR unreadable floor; createReviewDeferGate wrapping the PORT not the deliverer, because the deliverer only ever sees a rendered string; FAIL OPEN measured against inputs that do not throw — a NaN clock or an unparseable floor delivers — with notifier rejections propagated unchanged and a throwing observer unable to suppress a wake). index.ts (barrel + the dormancy statement, whose allow-list is empty). Three runtime specs, 70 legs (refreshed for round 5 on #509, finding R5-5 — these numbers are descriptive, the p4t6 scanner consumes only `paths`; they were stale by three rounds, which is exactly how a descriptive count rots, so each is measured from the source rather than inherited): a6-pr4-review-defer.test.ts (42: decisions, store law incl. the length-prefix collision pair, gate composition, plane behaviour, both-directions vocabulary reachability for all 8 reasons and all 9 refusals, with every producer NAMED and counted (round-4 R4-5, extended by round-5 R5-6: the census keeps the label of each producer and requires four of them for WAKE_KEY_UNADDRESSABLE, plus a leg pinning that reviewDeferEntryId throws rather than inventing a slot for a key nobody validated, and a leg pinning that an unreadable string clock and a throwing clock object answer two different codes and deliver either way)), a6-pr4-mutex-negative.test.ts (17: pass-through with an empty store, composition not replacement, the fail-open law against non-throwing NaN shapes, the poisoned-store panic path naming itself, the presence pin on approvalCaseId/legOrdinal via keyof, and the leg proving the tool layer and root.ts carry NO defer vocabulary so the withdrawal cannot be quietly undone), a6-pr4-lane-hygiene.test.ts (11: dormancy walked from disk with an EMPTY allow-list, no plane flag and no gate/store/port construction anywhere in the product, no clock no timer no node: in the lane — the clock leg carries EIGHTEEN needles and a hand-written plant per needle (round-5 R5-1 added setImmediate, requestAnimationFrame, openSync, appendFileSync, unlinkSync, getRandomValues after the prose had claimed categories the twelve tokens did not cover, and the two lists are asserted equal so they cannot drift apart), and the shipped dist surface referenced by nobody). No production file changes in this PR; the shared tool censuses are untouched — p6t6-bypass-scan stays at the fifteen sanctioned tools and the rc2 kit TEAM_TOOL_CATALOG stays at fifteen declared names.
